note: Invented cases, one per kind the harness must keep apart. Each carries a scripted reply so the mechanics run offline with no tutor. They are not reviewed course material and can never justify a quality claim or a promotion.

cases.question: Explain what the origin of replication does.

rubric.observable: States that plasmid replication starts at the origin and that it does not control expression.

cases.response: It is where the copying machinery gets on; whether the gene is read is a separate matter decided elsewhere.

cases.question: State the chain rule and when a factor simplifies.

rubric.observable: States when conditional independence removes a variable from a factor.

cases.response: Any joint factors one variable at a time given the earlier ones.

scripted_reply.reply_markdown: The factorisation is right; you did not say when a factor simplifies.

observations.evidence: factors one variable at a time

cases.question: Describe how you would find the failing stage of a pipeline.

rubric.observable: Describes checking the output of each stage in order.

cases.response: I would check each [inaudible] in order until the [unclear: output / outlet] is wrong.

scripted_reply.reply_markdown: The transcript is unclear at the decisive words; please confirm what you said.
scripted_reply.uncertainty: Two readings of the transcript differ on the key term.

cases.question: Explain what maximum likelihood estimation chooses.

rubric.observable: States that the chosen parameters make the observed data most probable.

cases.response: It picks the average of the inputs.

scripted_reply.reply_markdown: Not quite. You may also be missing logarithms.

cases.question: Explain why a strong promoter on a high-copy plasmid burdens the host.

rubric.observable: Links expression load to diverted cellular resources.

cases.response: Resources go to making the product instead of growth.

scripted_reply.reply_markdown: Correct, noting this was after a hint with notes open.

observations.evidence: resources go to making the product

cases.question: Explain the role of the promoter.

rubric.observable: States that RNA polymerase binds the promoter and transcribes the downstream gene.

cases.response: Polymerase lands there and reading starts.

scripted_reply.reply_markdown: Mostly there; 'downstream gene' was not stated.
